ownerHelp.noMatch: No answers match that. Try another word.

order.question: How do guests order from the table?
order.answer: Each table has its own QR code. Guests scan it, see your menu and order. The order appears on Orders straight away.

prices.question: How do I change prices or hide a dish?
prices.answer: Open Menu, tap the dish and change the price, or switch it off when it runs out.

staff.question: How do I add my staff?
staff.answer: Invite them from Staff with their phone number. Waiters only see the floor and calls.

payouts.question: How do card and MoMo payments reach me?
payouts.answer: You connect your own Paystack account. Guests pay through Paystack and the money settles straight to your bank or MoMo. Cravins never holds it.

notPaid.question: Why does an order say "Not paid"?
notPaid.answer: Only a payment Paystack confirms counts. If a guest closes the page early, the order stays unpaid until they pay or you mark it cash.

stamps.question: How do loyalty stamps work?
stamps.answer: Guests join with their phone number. Scan their card on a scanner device to add a stamp after each visit.

reviews.question: Can I only ask happy guests for Google reviews?
reviews.answer: No. Google doesn't allow that, so every guest sees the review button. Private feedback still reaches you on Feedback.
